d:
This story is about Henry…

Henry got married at a young age, believing he had finally found the person he could spend the rest of his life with. But he was wrong.

The person he trusted the most was only using him for his money—and by the time Henry realized the truth, he had already lost so much.

Now, Henry has one goal: take back everything that was taken from him.

But how far will he have to go?
What choices will he have to make?
And can he truly succeed without losing himself along the way?
